sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent painted animation cutout atlas for a cozy travel jigsaw. Make a TRUE transparent RGBA image, transparent space between subjects (no opaque backdrop, no paper rectangle, no glow, no grid, no checkerboard). Exactly FIVE independent watercolor/gouache cutouts arranged 3 columns by 2 rows, sixth bottom-right cell entirely empty. Every subject fully contained inside its own cell with very wide transparent gutters, nothing crosses halfway horizontal divider or any column divider. Keep each subject below 360px tall in 512x512 cell, centered. Soft hand-painted pigment and fine brushwork, warm gentle daylight from upper left, natural modest saturation; no text or UI. Subjects are detailed parts from a whole cozy illustrated scene, not stickers, no outline, no artificial rim or drop shadow. A violet tiled courtyard scene. TOP LEFT: a short cream-violet triangular fabric pennant with tiny top hanging loop. TOP MIDDLE: a small crimson geranium flower cluster on a single bottom stem. TOP RIGHT: a narrow soft ivory curtain panel with visible tiny top hanging loops, viewed frontally, draping down. BOTTOM LEFT: a small sage olive leaf sprig with bottom stem. BOTTOM MIDDLE: a delicate narrow horizontal pale-white cloud. Five isolated parts, no pot, no wall, no sky.
